SQL Server 2019 (All Components).label: SQL Server 2019

alternatives.label: GDR Only
alternatives.action: Apply GDR-only patch KB5102336 for security fixes without cumulative update changes (lower change risk)

alternatives.label: Migrate → 2022
alternatives.action: Plan upgrade to SQL Server 2022 (mainstream support until Jan 2033)

SQL Server 2022 (All Components).warning: ℹ️ Mainstream support until Jan 11, 2028; Extended until Jan 11, 2033.

alternatives.label: GDR Only
alternatives.action: Install GDR-only KB5102334 for security fixes without CU content. Lower change risk.
